note: Historical injury/illness scenario, not a current medical forecast. Explicit health-related non-participation only; missing/inactive rows are not assumed healthy. Coverage omits some absences and can understate risk. Player rates shrink toward the league rate using 40 observations; spell continuation uses 10 transitions. These smoothing choices are not tuned or validated. Independent player spells omit shared team risks. No automatic current-status or recovery-time inference.
